title: Stage A: L/T privileged within-class subgroup feasibility screen
objective: Test whether train-only L/T-derived within-class statistical strata transfer to two inner source users and contain incremental information about errors of a fixed Right-only diagnostic probe, conditional on gesture class, audit user, and a matched Right-derived stratum.
not_a_claim: not evidence of true kinematic or motion subgroups
not performance evidence for the historical Right-only CNN
incremental CMI is descriptive only relative to this fixed binary Right-cluster control, not all Right-view information
the row-level shuffle reference is not inferential because trial-level exchangeability is unresolved; no p-value, significance claim, or p-value-based gate is allowed
HV7/HV8 labels are class-conditional post-fit diagnostic strata, not deployment-time inputs or independent validation labels

data_boundary.quality_rule: Use the canonical shared quality mask: exclude subject 6/class 3 from source rows; the known subject 2/class 10-11 contradiction is outside the source-user selection, and subjects 1 and 2 are never read for labels or radar values. Before fitting, hash each retained source row’s full three-view triplet. Any exact source alias blocks before fit; no post-result deduplication or relabeling.
data_boundary.ids: Original row indices are preserved and hashed; all fitting uses only users 3-6. Users 7-8 are used only after the representations, clusters, and Right probe are frozen.
data_boundary.historical_use: Participants 3-8 have prior development use. Inner source audit is not independent validation and cannot support external-user claims.

frozen_method.input: Existing real-valued clutter-removed X, shape [N,3,90,189], with view order L,T,R.
frozen_method.feature: Per-view magnitude normalization followed by fixed 10x21 block averaging to 210 dimensions; no label-dependent feature search.
frozen_method.subgroups: Within each gesture class, StandardScaler and 16-component PCA are fit on users 3-6 only. KMeans K=2, n_init=10, seed=20261025 is fit once on concatenated L/T features; matched R-only clusters use the identical pipeline on R. IDs are ordered by the frozen first PCA coordinate.
frozen_method.error_probe: One fixed Right-only StandardScaler + RidgeClassifier(alpha=1.0,class_weight=balanced), fit on users 3-6 only; no CNN and no tuning.
controls: Right-only within-class groups from the same cluster pipeline
user identity and class-conditional user error information
1999 seeded random shuffles of L/T assignments within audit class x user x Right-group strata, preserving counts, reported only as a descriptive finite-shuffle reference
frozen_method.primary_statistic: Descriptive I(Right-probe error; L/T group | gesture class, audit user, Right-only group), in bits per audit sample; no inferential interpretation.
secondary_statistics: cluster occupancy per fit/audit user and class
audit error-rate direction for the two frozen group IDs per class/user

fixed_decision_rule.coverage_gate: At least 8/12 classes must have both groups with >=10 samples in each audit user and in >=3/4 fit users.
fixed_decision_rule.cross_user_error_gate: For at least 8/12 classes, both audit users must show the same group ID with >=5 percentage-point higher Right-probe error, with >=10 samples/group/user.
fixed_decision_rule.failure_action: Record which frozen descriptive criteria failed; do not change K, representation, split, groups, probe, thresholds, or shuffle count based on results. A non-supportive screen is limited to this frozen representation and probe and is not a general mechanism failure.
fixed_decision_rule.pass_action: Label only as descriptive_screen_supports_further_design. This is not a scientific GO or validated mechanism. It only indicates that the frozen representation may merit a separately designed validation study. Do not start Stage B or a CNN from this result; require separate authorization and design review.
fixed_decision_rule.inferential_boundary: No record-level permutation p-value is computed or reported. The finite-shuffle reference is not used for inference or any decision gate.

identity_alignment.within_stage_a: Per-class group IDs are assigned by frozen training-centroid order; audit users receive nearest frozen-centroid IDs. No audit refit, Hungarian matching, labels, or cross-user reassignment.
identity_alignment.across_outer_folds: No group IDs are compared or pooled across folds. Stage B, if separately authorized, fits fold-local group identities from that fold's training users and reports only fold-local diagnostics; cross-fold identity alignment is not claimed.

known_exact_duplicate_triplets.interpretation: The 100 verified exact aliases are across separately named HV2 G11/G12 source arrays, not merely duplicate manifest indices. Provenance cannot distinguish repeated acquisition from upstream copying. Participant 2 is sealed validation HV2 and outside source users 3-8, so these known pairs do not directly contaminate this source split. Prior metadata review lists no exact source-user duplicates in HV3-HV8; this run also performs a pre-fit exact-triplet scan on retained source rows and blocks if any alias is found.
known_exact_duplicate_triplets.participant_mapping: Participant ID 2 is the sealed validation participant HV2; source quality-audit paths explicitly name HV_02_G11 and HV_02_G12.

trial_independence.evidence_available: The preserved manifest has participant/class counts and row indices; source code shows 100 samples in each participant/class cell. The restored cache and reviewed source manifests provide no per-trial timestamps, acquisition order, session IDs, or repeat-level grouping metadata.
trial_independence.implication: Record-level exchangeability remains unresolved. No permutation p-value or inferential null statement is allowed. The count-preserving shuffles are only a descriptive finite-randomization reference; possible dependence can affect that reference and remains a limitation.

source_exchangeability.pre_run_action: Run the same diagnostic in a fresh run02 directory using the cumulative remaining CPU/wall budget after the prior pre-array failure. If a further exception occurs before arrays are opened, a code-only repair may be tested and retried using only the remaining cumulative budget. Once any source data are read, do not restart or resample; preserve/checkpoint and only recover the same calculation. Stop if cumulative resource use would exceed 900 CPU seconds or 900 wall seconds.
source_exchangeability.authorized_scope: One retry of the same descriptive-only Stage A computation is authorized after the prior attempt failed before np.load. No scientific protocol, data split, statistic, threshold, seed, CNN, tuning, extra analysis, or repeated completed computation is authorized.

compute_budget.environment: 5 CPU cores, about 17.7 GB available RAM, about 25.8 GB free at 2026-10-24 preflight; no GPU, no PyTorch, no active job.
compute_budget.execution: Each attempt runs in its own process group. Current retry uses kernel RLIMIT_CPU=899 seconds soft=hard and an independent parent monotonic wall timeout=898.9 seconds; single-thread numerical pools. Cumulative prior attempt usage is subtracted.
compute_budget.hard_budget: Maximum cumulative across attempts: 900 worker process CPU-seconds and 900 seconds wall time. Prior pre-array failure used 0.966 CPU / 1.003 wall; run02 is capped at 899 CPU and 898.9 wall, keeping cumulative totals under 900. Any timeout yields aborted/inconclusive and is never classified as scientific negative.
compute_budget.partial_artifacts: Retained source metadata and feature memmap flushed every 32 rows; exact source-triplet hashes/audit saved before model fitting; fitted per-class transforms/centroids/remaps and Right probe state atomically checkpointed; descriptive shuffle-reference values flushed every 50 draws. Parent preserves the last phase/progress and all partial artifacts.
compute_budget.run_manifest: Store amended protocol/code hashes, restore receipt and transfer manifest metadata hashes, selected-source raw triplet digest, Python/platform/numerical-library versions, observed thread pools, model states, descriptive shuffle-reference statistics, and hashes of run artifacts outside Git.

known: GEORGE: feature-space subclass clustering and group-robust mitigation without subclass labels.
Domino: cross-modal embeddings plus error-aware mixture-based systematic-error slice discovery.
EIIL: infer partitions informative for invariant learning.
AGRO: adversarial error-prone group discovery coupled to robust optimization.
LUPI and multimodal privileged learning: extra views available during training but absent at inference.
Xue et al. 2026: same-corpus X4 single/dual/tri-view recognition and fusion.
Project P1: cross-user multi-view teacher distillation into Right-only student; multiview OOF-shape control did not beat Right-only OOF or global smoothing.
prior_art_boundary.candidate_difference: Only the untested empirical question of whether L/T defines train-only, class-conditional strata that transfer across source users and add Right-error information beyond a same-pipeline Right-only grouping/user control. The group discovery, privileged information, and robust weighting algorithms are not claimed as new.
prior_art_boundary.novelty_status: not cleared; bounded literature search only

interpretation_boundary: No significance or inferential claims. Any CMI is descriptive relative only to the finite binary R-group control, not all R information. HV7/HV8 labels are post-fit class-conditioning diagnostics, not deployment inputs; those users have prior development use and are not independent validation.

one_shot_execution.prior_attempt_state: failed_exception before np.load; restore manifest enum mismatch
one_shot_execution.retry_policy: Code-only retries allowed only for a failure before np.load, without examining values or results, and only within remaining cumulative budget. After any data read, no restart or resampling; only recovery/completion of same calculation.
